Council approves $120M budget for fiscal 2027

The Lake Havasu City Council on Tuesday approved a $120 million budget for fiscal year 2027, with the bulk of new spending directed toward street repairs and water infrastructure.

The 6-1 vote followed nearly two hours of public comment, much of it focused on a proposed increase to the city's stormwater fee.
